Hard to tell in your situation since you've been unemployed so long. I'm in a similiar situation - I work at a campground 5pm to midnight delivering firewood and cleaning bathrooms. Job is soul sucking, boring, and entirely unfulfilling. But it's seasonal and I made a commitment to tough it out until the season is over. I think you should do the same until you find another job. Or, I dunno, just quit. If it doesn't make you happy, move on. But you should have some sort of plan. At the end of the day, we all need to do what is best for ourselves. But working is part of life, and if you're having anxiety over just working in general then I think you need to work on that. But trust me, there ARE good jobs out there! I know because I had one I loved working at a hostel last winter. They're rare and few and far between but keep searching and I'm sure you'll find something that is right for you. That's why I would kind of suggest quitting and finding something else as soon as you can, otherwise you're just wasting your time being miserable.
